study_guide.title: Cane and the Big Snow

pages.text: The air turned very cold. White flakes began to fall from the sky. "It's snow!" said Cane the Weather Dog. Then the wind began to blow, harder and harder. "When there's lots of snow AND strong wind," said Cane, "we call it a blizzard." The wind blew the snow all around. There was so much blowing snow that Cane could barely see! And it was cold enough to freeze water into ice. But Cane knew exactly what to do. He did not need to be cold or scared.
pages.ask: Can you wiggle your fingers like falling, blowing snow?

pages.text: "When it blizzards," said Cane, "we stay warm inside!"

Cane went inside where it was cozy and warm. He had a soft blanket and a warm snack. He watched the snow from the window. When Cane's family did go out, they bundled up — coat, hat, and gloves — and stayed together. Soon the snow stopped, and the world was white and quiet. Cane wagged his tail.
pages.ask: What would YOU bring to stay cozy inside?

pages.text: "You did it," said Cane. "You know all four wild storms now. You are a weather-ready graduate!"

study_guide.rule: When it blizzards, stay warm inside!

a low temperature; time for coats and warm clothes
